issues.item: Avoid Public Transport: Using public transport
issues.explanation: These avoidance items are hard to connect clinically to the rest of the profile. The reported triggers and memory content center on nature/combat-like environments, confrontation, and visible injuries, with appraisals of destroyed life, vigilance, and not belonging. Avoiding public transport and religious spaces introduces two specific situational avoidances that are not foreshadowed by any trigger, memory, or appraisal item and therefore look disconnected rather than part of the same trauma-linked pattern.

issues.item: Avoid Religious Spaces: Places of worship or religious gatherings
issues.explanation: This weakens cross-node coherence because the maladaptive strategies appear to address contexts not represented elsewhere in the profile. A clinician would expect avoidance to cluster around natural environments, confrontation, injuries, or other military-associated reminders given the selected triggers and memories.

issues.item: Avoid Religious Spaces: Places of worship or religious gatherings
issues.explanation: Avoiding religious spaces is not well supported by the rest of the profile. The triggers are nature, confrontations, and visible injuries, while memory/appraisal items center on unreality, grief, vigilance, and loss of belonging. Nothing else suggests trauma-linked distress in religious settings, so this strategy appears disconnected from the active trigger-memory/appraisal pattern and is hard to explain clinically from the selected items alone.
